Liang Qichao

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Liang Qichao / Q0479

English

By “renewing the people” we do not mean abandoning all that is old to follow others. Renewal has two senses: to refine what we already have, and to supply what we lack.
Thinker Liang Qichao
School Modern Chinese Enlightenment Thought
Source On Renewing the People
Theme Philosophy
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with On Renewing the People, within the tradition of Modern Chinese Enlightenment Thought. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Liang Qichao's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
